meta.name: FIT50 content engine icon manifest
meta.notes: The 9 originals are reused from the live FIT50 app's public/icons/ (webp, 96×96). Phase 5 converts them to SVG so the renderer can recolour by ground; Phase 0 ships them as webp for the test posts. New icons enter the library only after automated checks (manifest.schema) and by-eye approval.

library.subject: ice cubes
library.description: Three stacked ice cubes with a small motion line indicating a fresh chill.

library.subject: ice / cold shower water
library.description: A single ice cube dripping into a few droplet lines, suggesting a cold shower.

library.subject: book stack
library.description: Three stacked books with one slightly off-centre, ready to be picked up.

library.subject: lungs
library.description: A pair of lungs with a small breath line above, suggesting fresh air in.

library.subject: fuel pump
library.description: A fuel pump nozzle with a single drip, no fuel type shown.

library.subject: runner
library.description: A figure mid-stride, arms pumping, no face detail.

library.subject: brain
library.description: A brain with a small sparkle above the top, suggesting an open mind.

library.subject: feet
library.description: A pair of feet mid-step, with small motion lines behind the back foot.

library.subject: lips with straw
library.description: A pair of lips around a straw, a small droplet line above.
